A. 3.No later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, the Recipient, through SAG, shall hire as partof the PIU, and thereafter retain throughout Project implementation, two (2) Technical Liaisons, on terms and conditions acceptableto the Association, as further detailed in the Project Operational Manual.

Schedule 2. Section I.A.2.No later than one hundred twenty (120) days after the Effective Date, and for purposes of implementingPart 5.3 of the Project, the Recipient, through SAG, shall enter into a technical coordination agreement (“Inter-institutionalAgreement”) with SEDESOL and any other relevant entity, as applicable; all under terms and conditions acceptable to the Bank.

Schedule 2. Section I.A.3.No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date, the Recipient, through SAG, shall hire as partof the PIU, and thereafter retain throughout Project implementation, one (1) Technical Liaison, on terms and conditions acceptableto the Bank, as further detailed in the Project Operational Manual.

Schedule 2. Section I.G. 1For purposes of carrying out Part 1.(b) of the Project, the Recipient shall maintain throughout Projectimplementation, a credit guarantee fund satisfactory to the Association, set up with the Recipient's own resources with at least anamount equivalent to one million three hundred thousand Dollars ($1,300,000), to be used exclusively to guarantee loans made byPFIs for Agribusiness Subprojects, all in accordance with the structure and procedures set forth in the Project Operational Manual.

Schedule 2. Section II. 1.The Recipient, through SAG, shall furnish to the Association each Project Report not later thanforty-five (45) days after the end of each calendar semester, covering the calendar semester.

title.narrative: Women beneficiaries demonstrating an improvement in empowerment (Pro-WEAI)

comment.narrative:
Measurement of this indicator has not yet started, as the technical instruments and the methodological plan required for its application are still under preparation. The M&E team has scheduled a specialized workshop for the second quarter of 2026 to design the instruments, data collection protocols, and training plan needed to measure women's empowerment using the PRO-WEAI methodology.
Once this preparatory phase is completed, and with the participation of the business development service providers (PSDEs) during the implementation of the business plans, it will be possible to collect reliable and comparable information to report progress on this indicator.
